The rejection says the correction must name a journal. I'll submit with corrects_jrnl_no null, since no journal number is available, and make the correction structurally valid.

This is a judgment call. Cash credited 5248.89 (payment journal: Dr 2000 / Cr 1000) against an invoice of 5248.88 leaves AP control debited 0.01 more than the invoice credit. Status changes are not allowed for this finding type, so the problem has to be the missing journal reference. I can't discover the payment journal number, so the best I can do is resubmit the minimal correction in period 11 and state the limitation plainly.
